text: I attached no value to them. They were quite worthless to me.’ Either she saw in his face that he knew, or she only feared in her conscience that he knew, that she spoke of some of her husband’s gifts. She stopped, and reddened again. If he had not known it before, he would have known it then, though he had been a much duller man than he was. ‘Since then, I have given my brother, at various times, what money I could spare: in short, what money I have had.
